html:
When people think of Nha Trang, they often picture a vibrant coastal city with long stretches of white sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters. However, hidden within Nha Trang Bay lies a lesser-known gem Hon Tam Island, a destination that remains wonderfully pristine while still offering a wide range of exciting activities.

Hon Tam is not only an ideal place to relax, but also a paradise for fun, adventure, and cultural discovery. Let’s explore Hon Tam Island together and gather everything you need to plan a perfect Nha Trang getaway.

Hon Tam Island – Relaxation And Entertainment In A Tropical Paradise

Hon Tam, also known as Thuy Kim Son, is one of the largest and most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay. It captivates visitors with its natural beauty and the perfect balance between lively entertainment and luxurious resort experiences.

Located just 7 kilometers southeast of Nha Trang city center, Hon Tam can be reached by speedboat in only 10–15 minutes, offering a quick escape from the city’s hustle and bustle into a tranquil island retreat without sacrificing comfort or convenience.

Location And Natural Beauty Of Hon Tam

Situated in the heart of Nha Trang Bay, one of the world’s most beautiful bays, Hon Tam Island is blessed with untouched natural scenery. Covering an area of approximately 110 hectares, the island features lush green hills, over 1 kilometer of soft white sandy beaches, and calm, jade-colored waters year-round.

Hon Tam is also home to a diverse marine ecosystem, with colorful coral reefs and tropical fish, creating a vivid underwater world ideal for snorkeling and diving. Its semi-isolated location helps preserve its peaceful atmosphere while remaining easily accessible.

The Origin Of Hon Tam’s Name And History

The name “Hon Tam” comes from the island’s shape, which resembles a giant green silkworm resting in the sea. The island is also known as Thuy Kim Son, meaning “Golden Mountain in the Water,” symbolizing prosperity and natural richness.

According to local legends, Hon Tam once served as a shelter for fishermen and a trading stop in ancient times. Traces of traditional culture remain, adding a historical charm that enriches the island’s appeal.

Best Time To Visit Hon Tam Island

The best time to visit Hon Tam is during Nha Trang’s dry season (January to September). The most ideal months are April to August, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and outdoor activities are at their best. Temperatures range from 26–30°C, creating pleasant conditions for swimming and water sports.

Visitors seeking fewer crowds may prefer February or March, when the weather remains beautiful but tourism is less busy. The rainy season (October to December) is less recommended due to rough seas and limited activities.

How To Get To Hon Tam Island

From Nha Trang city center, travelers can reach Cau Da Port by taxi, motorbike, or bus. From there, several options are available:

  • Speedboat: The fastest and most popular option, taking 10–15 minutes. Round-trip prices range from 200,000–300,000 VND per person.

  • Wooden Boat: A slower, more economical option (30–45 minutes), costing around 100,000–150,000 VND per person.

  • Private Boat Charter: Ideal for groups seeking privacy and flexibility. Prices vary depending on boat type and rental duration.

Many resorts on the island also provide private transfer services for overnight guests.

Things To Do On Hon Tam Island

Relax On Hon Tam Beach

Hon Tam Beach boasts fine white sand and crystal-clear waters, perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Visitors can relax under palm trees, enjoy beach games, or simply listen to the soothing sound of waves. Facilities include sun loungers, umbrellas, and designated safe swimming areas for children.

Visit Hoang Hoa Village – A Traditional Island Hamlet

Hoang Hoa Village offers a journey back in time with five preserved traditional houses over 100 years old. Inside, you’ll find antique tools and household items that recreate traditional Vietnamese village life.

The village regularly hosts cultural festivals such as the Hung Kings’ Commemoration Ceremony, Cherry Blossom Festival, and Whale Worship Festival. Visitors can enjoy traditional music performances, handicraft demonstrations, pottery making, and rice wine brewing an immersive cultural experience.

Unwind At Hon Tam Mud Bath Complex

Hon Tam is home to Vietnam’s largest island-based mud bath complex, covering over 16,000 m². Surrounded by mountains and overlooking Nha Trang Bay, this wellness sanctuary offers natural mineral mud baths, herbal soaking pools, hydrotherapy, waterfalls, and Jacuzzi pools.

Ticket prices range from 400,000–600,000 VND, with premium packages including spa treatments and massages.

Have Fun At The Floating Inflatable Park

Spanning 4,200 m² and accommodating up to 750 guests, Hon Tam’s floating inflatable park is a massive playground on the sea. Activities include climbing walls, obstacle courses, slides, balance challenges, and giant inflatables perfect for families and groups of friends.

Try Thrilling Water Sports

  • Flyboarding: Experience the thrill of flying above the sea with water-powered jet boots. Price: 600,000–800,000 VND / 15 minutes.

  • Parasailing: Soar above Nha Trang Bay and enjoy panoramic views. Price: 500,000–700,000 VND per flight.

  • Jet Skiing: Speed across the waves and feel the adrenaline. Price: 300,000–500,000 VND / 30 minutes.

  • Kayaking: Paddle at your own pace and explore hidden corners of the island. Price: 100,000–150,000 VND per hour.

  • Mini Golf: Enjoy a relaxing game surrounded by lush greenery. Price: 200,000–300,000 VND per round.

Snorkeling And Diving

Hon Tam’s calm waters and shallow reefs make it ideal for snorkeling and scuba diving. Colorful coral formations and diverse marine life await beneath the surface.

  • Snorkeling: 200,000–300,000 VND per person

  • Scuba Diving: 700,000–1,000,000 VND per dive (includes instructor and equipment)

Enjoy Nightlife At Hon Tam Beach Bar

As the sun sets, Hon Tam’s beach bar comes alive with tropical cocktails, light bites, and energetic EDM music. Weekend DJ performances and beach parties create a lively atmosphere under the stars.

Suggested One-Day Itinerary On Hon Tam Island

Morning (7:30–11:30)
Speedboat transfer to the island, beach relaxation, swimming, kayaking, and photo sessions.

Lunch (11:30–13:00)
Seafood buffet at an island restaurant.

Afternoon (13:00–16:00)
Visit Hoang Hoa Village, enjoy mud baths, or try water sports like flyboarding or parasailing.

Evening (After 16:00)
Return to the mainland or stay overnight for a beachfront dinner, stargazing, beach bar entertainment, or resort activities.

Where To Stay On Hon Tam Island

Hon Tam Resort is the island’s flagship accommodation, offering luxury in harmony with nature. The resort features 114 rooms and bungalows with sea or garden views, modern amenities, infinity pools, beachfront restaurants, bars, and evening entertainment.

Room rates typically start from 800,000 VND per night, with higher-end villas costing several million VND per night. Booking in advance is highly recommended, especially during peak seasons.

Food And Dining On Hon Tam

Fresh seafood is the highlight, including grilled lobster, steamed crab, spicy grilled squid, and various sea snails. Visitors should also try local Nha Trang specialties such as:

  • Fish cake noodle soup

  • Ninh Hoa grilled pork rolls

  • Banh can (mini rice pancakes)

  • Mai fish salad

  • Seafood banh xeo (Vietnamese pancakes)

Popular Service Packages On Hon Tam

  • Mud Bath Package: 400,000–600,000 VND

  • Beach Fun Package: 350,000–500,000 VND

  • All-Inclusive Combo (Mud Bath + Beach + Lunch): 700,000–900,000 VND

  • Private Beach Huts: 200,000–500,000 VND per day

Important Travel Tips

  • Book tickets and services in advance during peak season

  • Bring sunscreen, swimwear, hats, and waterproof cameras

  • Protect the environment do not damage coral or litter

  • Follow safety instructions for water sports

  • Carry some cash for small expenses

  • Stay hydrated and avoid excessive sun exposure

Final Thoughts

Hon Tam Island is a rare destination where untouched natural beauty meets modern tourism services. From relaxation and wellness to adventure and culture, Hon Tam offers a complete island escape in Nha Trang.

We hope this guide helps you plan a memorable and fulfilling journey to this stunning tropical paradise.
